title: dryas octopetala f. integrifolia
intro: Dryas octopetala f. integrifolia, commonly known as Mountain Avens, is a flowering plant species that belongs to the Rosaceae family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, which can help soothe skin irritations and wounds. The therapeutic actions of Mountain Avens include wound healing, anti-oxidative, and anti-edematous properties, making it a potential remedy for skin conditions and injuries. The bioactive constituents of Mountain Avens include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
